experiment: Separately linked floorplan_pack.cpp with the existing failure-set-reconstruction-experiment.patch, combined with current production obstacle-union bounds and direct nearest search. Production sources/binaries unchanged.
workload: Carrier 162x150, granular-minor+vertical+estimator-first; same options as 2026-10-18-facing-obstacle-union.json smaller screen, including 1024 joint states, 8 poses, 4096 frontier nodes, 3 continuations, victim shapes and explicit order 0.
decision: Do not enable reconstruction. Combining it with the corrected obstacle-union bounds still does not recover the smaller carrier and increases actual retry work.
next_investigation: Audit the physical basis and centroid dependence of the hard 90-degree output-facing rule before adding further searches to satisfy it. Current code derives this rule from external.downstream/output_roles and wired membership, with placement/v2 as its reported basis. No constraint has been relaxed by this experiment.

initial_hardware_review.document: SNVSBD5D Rev. D, July 2022, section 11.1, page 47
initial_hardware_review.findings: Layout guidance addresses local input switching loops, bypass/boot/feedback placement, ground planes, direct wide power paths, heat spreading and small switch-node area. This section does not specify a 90-degree relationship between output-part and subsystem centroids.
initial_hardware_review.limits: This is not proof arbitrary layouts are safe. Routing, parasitics, noise and thermal requirements remain relevant. No acceptance policy changed; review other provenance and tests before deciding how to represent the centroid heuristic.

limits: Single diagnostic, no accepted board, no performance comparison, no full qualification or completion claim.
